name: leftFun_implicitFunction_eq_leftFun
statement: ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 φ.pt, φ.leftFun (φ.implicitFunction (φ.leftFun φ.pt) (φ.rightFun x)) = φ.leftFun φ.pt

name: rightFun_implicitFunction_eq_rightFun
statement: ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 φ.pt, φ.rightFun (φ.implicitFunction (φ.leftFun φ.pt) (φ.rightFun x)) = φ.rightFun x

name: hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction_fderiv
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt (φ.implicitFunction (φ.leftFun φ.pt)) (fderiv 𝕜 (φ.implicitFunction (φ.leftFun φ.pt)) (φ.rightFun φ.pt)) (φ.rightFun φ.pt)

name: implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : OpenPartialHomeomorph E (F × f'.ker)

name: implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply_ker
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) (y : f'.ker) : hf.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph f f' hf' (y + a) = (f (y + a), y)

name: implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph_self
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : hf.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph f f' hf' a = (f a, 0)

name: mem_implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : a ∈ (hf.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph f f' hf').source

name: mem_implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : (f a, (0 : f'.ker)) ∈ (hf.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph f f' hf').target

name: map_implicitFunction_eq
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : ∀ᶠ p : F × f'.ker in 𝓝 (f a, 0), f (hf.implicitFunction f f' hf' p.1 p.2) = p.1

name: implicitFunction_apply_image
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : hf.implicitFunction f f' hf' (f a) 0 = a

name: eq_implicitFunction
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, hf.implicitFunction f f' hf' (f x) (hf.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph f f' hf' x).snd = x

name: to_implicitFunction
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' a) (hf' : f'.range = ⊤) : HasStrictFDerivAt (hf.implicitFunction f f' hf' (f a)) f'.ker.subtypeL 0
